deficiencies.description: The rewrite states that the slice through a tumour illustrates explanting the tumour ('illustrates this'), but the text does not link the figure/slice to explantation; it only states that the slice and stain are used to look at morphology.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: often they will explant the tumor. Here you're looking at a slice through a tumor and a stain to look at the morphology.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: A slice through a tumour, with a stain to show the morphology, illustrates this [FIGURE].

considerations.sourcePassage: Primary cells really don't grow in culture.
considerations.reason: 'Really' functions as a conversational intensifier rather than a scientific hedge, so its omission in 'Primary cells do not grow in culture' is an allowed stylistic change.

considerations.sourcePassage: Whoops, I forgot to start my clock. Okay.
considerations.reason: This is a casual remark to the audience / self-directed remark and its removal is an allowed change.
